description: Find brands in a category with the biggest recent growth in seller count and observations. Use when the user asks 'fastest growing brands in Toys', 'top growers in this category', 'which brands are trending up', or any category-scoped growth question.

category_name.description: Category name (fuzzy match if category_id not provided).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

since_months.description: Months to compare (default 3, max 6). Compares latest month vs earliest.

name: category_top_growers
